login.title: Admin sign-in
login.sub: Enter your e-mail and password to open the shop's back end.
login.emailHint: Write the full e-mail address, with the @ in it.
login.codeSub: Type the code your authenticator app shows right now.
login.pwSub: Before your first visit, replace the password the owner gave you with your own. A long sentence works best.
login.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
login.twoFactorSetup: The owner has switched on two-step sign-in. The page to set it up for this account comes in a later step — please tell the owner.
login.noDb: This server has no database connected yet, so nobody can sign in.

page.noAccess: You do not have permission to see this page. Ask the owner to give it to you.
page.noDb: This server has no database connected yet.

integrations.erpLinkNote: Each store has its own ERP link, with its own keys: Settings → ERP link. The ERP row here is the installation-wide one the stores still on the old ERP contract use.
integrations.title: Keys & connections
integrations.intro: Every key the shop needs lives here, encrypted — never in the code. A new owner or a new server only needs new keys here.
integrations.cardSub: A saved key is never shown again.
integrations.standby: Another storage is on; this one waits

mode.MOCK: Mock mode — nothing reaches the real service

integrations.removeConfirm: Remove the key for {name}? The key is switched off (not deleted) and this connection goes back to mock mode.
integrations.note: Keys are kept encrypted in the vault. Removing a key switches it off; nothing is deleted. Until a key is in and its test passes, the connection runs on a mock — the shop never waits.
integrations.vaultMissing: The vault's master key is not set on the server, so no key can be saved yet.

modal.title: Connect {name}
modal.lock: Kept encrypted in the vault, never shown again. A new key replaces the old one.

toast.savedFailed: Key saved, but the test did not pass — the connection stays on mock

erpCalls.title: The ERP asks the shop
erpCalls.sub: When you click "Top products" or "Customers" in the ERP, the ERP asks this shop, live. The shop answers only a call signed with this store's own secret, and never sends a list by itself.
erpCalls.base: Address to put into the ERP
erpCalls.baseUnknown: Shown once the shop has its own address
erpCalls.baseHow: In the ERP: shop settings → the site's address. The ERP signs with the signing secret above (or the webhook secret while that is empty).
erpCalls.switch: Let the ERP ask for top products and customers
erpCalls.on: On: a correctly signed call is answered, and logged below
erpCalls.off: Off: every call is refused (and counted below)
erpCalls.v5: Answers only after this store moves to the new ERP contract (v6)
erpCalls.refusedNone: No call refused in the last {days} days
erpCalls.refusedHooks: ERP events (webhooks) refused in the last {days} days: {n}
erpCalls.refusedHooksNone: No ERP event (webhook) refused in the last {days} days

code.NO_SECRET: Refused: no secret saved for this store
code.SHARED_SECRET: Refused: two stores have the same secret
code.BAD_QUERY: Refused: the question was not clear
code.RATE_LIMITED: Refused: too many wrong calls this minute

integrations.managedLink: set up on the Backups page

azureBlob.name: Azure Blob storage
azureBlob.desc: Photos, media and backups (fast restore to any minute)

fields.endpoint: Address — only for a test server

googleDrive.name: Google Drive
googleDrive.desc: Daily encrypted backup copy in your own Google Drive (one-click sign-in on the Backups page)

fields.clientId: Client ID (your own Google client, type "TVs and Limited Input devices")
fields.refreshToken: Google access (made by Connect on the Backups page)
fields.folderId: Backup folder (made at the first connect)

googleDriveAddOnly.name: Second Google Drive (add-only)
googleDriveAddOnly.desc: A third backup copy that cannot be deleted

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.desc: CDN, cache clearing, protection. Until the token is in, cache clearing is practised here and nothing is sent

fields.zoneId: Zone ID (Cloudflare → your domain → Overview → API)
fields.hosts: Shop host names, separated by commas (e.g. shop.example.com)
fields.apiToken: API token with the zone's "Cache Purge" right only

telegram.name: Telegram (AI 360 channel)
telegram.desc: Server and backup alerts. Until the bot token and the chat are in and the test passes, alerts stay on the server

fields.chatId: Chat ID — where the alerts go (a number like -1001234567890, or @channelname)
fields.baseUrl: Address — only for a test server

cloudflareOrigin.name: Cloudflare origin certificate
cloudflareOrigin.desc: The certificate the server shows Cloudflare, so its SSL/TLS mode can be Full (strict). Until a pair passes the test, the server keeps its automatic certificate

fields.certificate: Origin certificate (Cloudflare → SSL/TLS → Origin Server → Create certificate; the whole text with BEGIN and END)
fields.privateKey: Private key (shown once when the certificate is made)

s3.name: S3-compatible storage
s3.desc: AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2 — a place for photos and media instead of Azure

fields.endpoint: Address — for services other than AWS

extasErp.name: Our ERP
extasErp.desc: Stock and variants come from the ERP; orders go to it. Practice mode until the address and keys are in

fields.apiKey: API key (from the ERP's E-commerce page)
fields.signingSecret: Signing secret for the ERP's calls to the shop (leave empty to use the webhook secret)

bkash.name: bKash payments
bkash.desc: Customers pay online with bKash on its own page. Practice mode (no money moves) until the address and the four keys from bKash are in and the test passes

fields.baseUrl: bKash address (https://…, the sandbox or live one bKash gave you)

localDisk.name: Server disk
localDisk.desc: When no other storage is on, photos and media stay on the server's own disk

pageReader.name: Product page reader
pageReader.desc: Reads a supplier's or brand's product page for "Import from a link". No key: give a page to test with.

fields.testUrl: A product page to test with (https://…)
fields.userAgent: Name sent to the sites read — optional

steadfast.name: Steadfast Courier
steadfast.desc: Book parcels and read their status. Practice mode until both keys are in and the test passes

fields.baseUrl: Address — only for a test server

pathao.name: Pathao Courier
pathao.desc: Book parcels and read their status. Practice mode until the four keys and the store are in and the test passes

fields.clientId: Client ID (Pathao merchant panel → Developers API)
fields.storeId: Pathao store ID the parcels go out from (merchant panel → Stores)
fields.baseUrl: Address — only for a test server

bulkSmsBd.name: SMS gateway (BulkSMSBD)
bulkSmsBd.desc: Order SMS and sign-in codes. Mock until the key is in and the test (the balance) passes: nothing is sent before that

fields.senderId: Sender id the gateway gave you (its number; the masking name is set in Messages → Channels & limits)
fields.baseUrl: Address — only for a test server

whatsappCloud.name: WhatsApp Business (Meta)
whatsappCloud.desc: Order WhatsApp messages, their delivery receipts and the customer's replies. Mock until the keys are in and the test (reading the phone number) passes: nothing is sent before that. Webhook address: /api/whatsapp/webhook

fields.accessToken: Access token (Meta app → WhatsApp → API setup; a permanent system-user token)
fields.appSecret: App secret (Meta app → Settings → Basic) — checks that the webhook really comes from Meta
fields.verifyToken: Verify token — any long word you choose; type the same one in Meta's webhook settings
fields.phoneNumberId: Phone number ID (Meta app → WhatsApp → API setup)
fields.businessAccountId: WhatsApp Business account ID (the templates live there)
fields.apiVersion: API version — leave empty for the one the shop was built with
fields.baseUrl: Address — only for a test server

messengerPage.name: Facebook Messenger (Page)
messengerPage.desc: The Page's Messenger messages in the Support inbox, and the team's replies. Mock until the keys are in and the test (reading the Page) passes: nothing is sent before that. Messages stay in the Page inbox too. Webhook address: /api/messenger/webhook

fields.pageAccessToken: Page access token (Meta app → Messenger → API settings; a long-lived Page token)
fields.appSecret: App secret (Meta app → Settings → Basic) — checks that the webhook really comes from Meta
fields.verifyToken: Verify token — any long word you choose; type the same one in Meta's webhook settings
fields.pageId: Page ID (the Page → About → Page transparency, or Meta app → Messenger)
fields.apiVersion: API version — leave empty for the one the shop was built with
fields.baseUrl: Address — only for a test server

googleSearchConsole.name: Google Search Console
googleSearchConsole.desc: Lists the shop's properties and hands Google the sitemap (Website → SEO). Until the key is in and the test passes, nothing is sent

fields.serviceAccountJson: Service account key (the whole JSON file from Google Cloud; add its e-mail as a user of the property)

bingWebmaster.name: Bing Webmaster Tools
bingWebmaster.desc: Lists the shop's sites and hands Bing the sitemap (Website → SEO). Until the key is in and the test passes, nothing is sent

fields.apiKey: API key (Bing Webmaster → Settings → API access)

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
errors.NOT_CONNECTED: This connection has no key yet.
errors.NOT_AVAILABLE: This connection is not built yet.
errors.VAULT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The vault's master key is not set on the server.
errors.WRONG_CODE: That code is not right; please check it.
errors.WRONG_PASSWORD: The current password is not right.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: That password will not do — use a longer sentence of your own.
errors.invalid-credentials: The e-mail or password is not right.
errors.ADDRESS_NOT_ALLOWED: The admin opens only from the addresses the owner listed, and this internet connection is not one of them. Use an allowed connection, or ask the owner to add this one.
errors.ADDRESS_NOT_ON_LIST: The list must hold the address you are saving from ({fields}), or you would lock yourself out.
errors.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again after {time}.
errors.cross-site-request: A request from another site was refused.
errors.database-not-configured: This server has no database connected yet.
errors.server-error: Something went wrong on the server; please try again shortly.
errors.network: Could not reach the server — check the connection and try again.

reasons.paymentNotReady: Receiver did not have the money ready

courier.practice: Practice — nothing is sent to a courier

code.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: Not confirmed, held, cancelled or already sent
code.SHORTAGE_OPEN: A packing card is still open
code.GIFT_DATE: Gift — waits for its booking day
code.NO_RECEIVER: Name, mobile number or address missing
code.COURIER_REFUSED: The courier refused it (see the reason)
code.NO_WEIGHT: A piece has no weight — this courier needs it
code.AREA_UNMAPPED: Waiting: this courier does not know the area yet — pair it on the courier's page
code.AREA_UNKNOWN: Waiting: the order has no known area — fix the address first
code.PHOTO_REQUIRED: Waiting for the packing photo (or the owner's override)
